children: Bitcoin miner CleanSpark reported unaudited operating data for the period ended August 31, 2026, saying it mined 593 BTC in August and 4,903 BTC year to date. According to ChainCatcher, the company said its operating hashrate reached 50 EH/s, with fleet efficiency of 16.07 J/Th and total contracted power of 1.8 GW, including 808 MW in use.

CleanSpark said its Bitcoin treasury totaled 13,703 BTC at the end of August. The company also sold 821 BTC in August through spot sales, call option exercises, and delta-neutral basis trades at an average realized price of $65,420.

The company said it is accelerating construction of a high-performance computing data center in Sandersville, Georgia, where it has signed a 20-year lease agreement worth $6.6 billion with a high-rated technology tenant.

title: CleanSpark Mines 593 Bitcoin in August, Raises Holdings to 13,703 BTC
